gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Wiry, wide-mouthed, and a bit cheeky. Happy Monkey draws its heading like bent wire, while Sawarabi Gothic keeps a sans body with open curves, best given a generous size.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-voces: Love Ya Like A Sister looks like pipe cleaners bent into letters, with stubby ascenders. Voces follows in a tall-lowercase plain sans whose reed-pen curves thicken slightly, so the loose, outward-pointing heading gets a steadier partner beneath it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-cal-sans: Wide-spaced and restless, with curves that won't quite close. Cal Sans takes over below as a sans-serif with one stroke width and a tall x-height, giving the heading's loose energy something sturdy to lean on.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-zilla-slab: Bold, with a pixel-built line weight that never changes and a c as open as a bent paperclip. Zilla Slab adds sturdy slab-serif curves beneath.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Chunky, hand-drawn and grinning, with a mouth wide as a cut tin lid. Encode Sans Semi Condensed keeps a sans body with an open s, so long paragraphs move along smoothly.
